method: Source and test-evidence audit plus seven fresh generation/compilation probes. Prior passing tests are cited, not rerun or counted as new passes.
status_policy: A compound requirement is tested only when every acceptance facet has executed evidence. Runtime capability alone is partial, not tested.
reference_baseline: Not frozen: current local requirements inventory audited; upstream immutable release/commit and exhaustive option audit still pending.
